CLASSES.VERIFIED_COMMERCIAL_OUTCOME: Verified revenue/payment or other explicitly scoped commercial result; intent or forecast is insufficient.
CLASSES.VERIFIED_OPERATIONAL_OUTCOME: Verified execution or process result; does not imply revenue or user benefit.
CLASSES.VERIFIED_PRODUCT_USER_OUTCOME: Verified user result with scoped measurement; does not itself prove clinical effectiveness or causation.
CLASSES.VERIFIED_DECISION_LEARNING_OUTCOME: Verified decision or learning that changes an explicit uncertainty, supported by recorded evidence; not a commercial result.
CLASSES.HISTORICAL_PUBLIC_OUTCOME: Public historical outcome with source, scope and verification limits; not automatically verified or attributable to Belanar.

COUNTER_SCOPE: This candidate contains zero outcome records; no historical or business totals are inferred.
COUNT_RULE: Count unique OUTCOME_ID within TYPE only after evidence meets that class. Never sum or merge classes into a success counter. Related class records use distinct IDs and evidence scopes, and may reference the same event without claiming independent causes.

CAUSAL_ATTRIBUTION.rule: Outcome existence does not establish Belanar causation. Support attribution separately, recording alternative explanations and limits.

REUSE_ELIGIBILITY.rule: Reuse only within evidenced scope and authorization; historical/public provenance alone does not grant testimonial or clinical claims.

FIELD_GUIDANCE.TIMESTAMP: ISO-8601 event time; unknown historical time explicitly recorded, never invented.
FIELD_GUIDANCE.EVIDENCE: Inspectable evidence references and verification method/reviewer; no placeholder counts as verified.
FIELD_GUIDANCE.SCOPE: Population, product/version, measurement window and boundaries.
FIELD_GUIDANCE.SOURCE: Origin and lineage distinct from action performer.
